name: yt-downloader-firefox
description: Wtyczka Firefox do pobierania MP3 i MP4 z YouTube, bez dodatkowych programów

scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename "yt-downloader-{version}-unsigned.xpi" --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --channel unlisted --api-key $AMO_JWT_ISSUER --api-secret $AMO_JWT_SECRET
